{{Quote|We make our egg salad fresh daily with hard-boiled Grade Aurek gartro eggs, tangy emulsauce, Boontaspiced mustard, taba leaves, Serrian salt and black hole pepper.|From the menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex's" />}}
'''Gartro egg salad''' was a type of [[Salad/Legends|salad]] prepared in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was owned by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] chef [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], until its destruction in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
